results.title: Generative AI Powered Search Engines for Literature Search - When to Use and What to Look Out For
results.description: Using Generative AI powered search engines for literature review is the latest thing - even Google Scholar now has Scholar labs and SMU libraries subscribes to Scite assistant and Deep Research tools like Undermind.ai, Consensus and more. Learn how they differ from conventional search engines such as Google Scholar, when to use them, and what to watch out for! Great for students on Capstone Projects, postgraduates, and researchers!
